text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, I decided
to accompany Mejiro Bright on her shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting~.
I truly appreciate you keeping me company~.

Without making anyone wait long enough to warrant an apology,
Mejiro Bright purchased a certain perfume without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This is a French perfume
that has been cherished for generations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The bird-themed bottle cap is so elegant and lovelyâ
Hii, Bright-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, my! Lady Maruzen~.
Good day to you, what a coincidence~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Are you out shopping too, Bright-chan?
...Wait, huh? Those bags are—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my! I actually just went shopping
at that very same boutique myself! Look!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...?
Could it be that Maruzen-sama and I bought the exact same thing?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right!
It's the exact same brand~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bright-chan, you really are quite a trendy girl, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a perfume that's super trendy
among the hip youth right now!
Even I only found out about it recently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Indeed, she did mention using it ever since it was in fashion~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Was saying"... Wait, huh? Bright-chan, what do you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"This is a gift for my mother.
I thought I'd send along a present with my usual letter~."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so! Bright-chan,
you're so very thoughtful of your mother!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...My mother never rushed me, even though I've been
laid-back since childhood,
and patiently watched over me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It was the same when I chose to pursue racing as an Umamusume of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sister Ryan and Dober take my hands,
and Mother gently pushes me forward—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The fact that I am able to run here at Tracen Academy today
is also thanks to my mother.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see... What a wonderful mother.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, but even so,
to think Maruzen-sama wears the exact same perfume
as my mother—what a wonderful coincidence~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? R-Right!
Maybe I'd get along well with Bright-chan's mother... Ahaha...
choice_data_list: Maybe we'll really hit it off if we meet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way.
If you would like, I would be delighted
to introduce you next time~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I hope we can find common ground, but there's a generation gap, right?
I wonder if Italian food will suit your tastes...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Itameshi...? 
Shall we go ahead and ask?
Even after that, more common ground was found between Mejiro Bright's mother and Maruzensky, leading to a very lively conversation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it,
I just remembered something—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The tiramisu that Maruzen-sama always enjoys
is also a favorite of my mother's~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really...?! I see, I see!
That's it, of course! The mystery is finally solved!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bright-chan's mother still has such a totally hip and active sense of style, doesn't she!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Active and thriving"... Why yes,
Mother is certainly in high spirits~♪
It felt like the conversation was going off-track, but figuring it was best not to nitpick, I simply listened along.
